Make it your own Custom crêpes & extras

Something sweet

Choose from fruit, Nutella, Belgian chocolate, cookie crumbles, whipped cream, marshmallows, pistachio crème, ice cream and NY cheesecake.

Something savory

Build with spinach, tomato, avocado, egg, mozzarella, Parmesan, Gruyère, ham, chicken or bacon, with your choice of sauces and seasonings.

Signature recipes come as listed. For a different combination, ask us about a custom crêpe. Please tell our team about any food allergies before ordering.
